name: admin-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Product/inventory management and order management + reporting calls.

dependencies.name: store-auth
dependencies.description: Required sign-in for the store admin; ceramics-api authorizes admin endpoints by the admin Thunder group.

description: The store owner's administrative console: create/edit/publish/delete products, adjust stock, manage order fulfillment status, and view sales reporting. Always requires sign-in. Separate deployable from the public storefront because it serves a different user with a different release cadence.
